correctness.rationale: For unit row normals (1,0),(1,0),(c,s), the two projection matrices satisfy P^2=P, Q^2=Q, PQP=uP, QPQ=uQ with u=c^2. Enumerating the three possible Q positions gives S=[(u+u^2)P+uQ]/3. The iid adjoint Gram channel L(H)=(2PHP+QHQ)/3 gives T=L^3(I)=[(8+6u+4u^2)P+(1+6u+2u^2)Q]/27. Therefore T-S=(1-u)[(8+5u)P+(1-2u)Q]/27. Positive coefficients and the determinant (1-u)^3(8+5u)(1-2u)/729 prove exactly the all-vector threshold u<=1/2 for u<1. At e=(1,0), the sign is (1-u)^2(1-2u)/27; at u=16/25 the exact risks are 48/625 and 1179/15625. Two-row enumeration yields (1-u)(P+Q)/4 positive semidefinite. A standard-library exact verifier independently enumerated all 6 and 27 paths, 5 rational directions, and distinct-row and two-row witnesses, but finite tests are not used as proof of the real-parameter result. The 3x2 system has full column rank for s>0. Uniform labeled sampling and one epoch are explicit assumptions.

originality.rationale: The comparison is the Loewner ordering of second-moment Gram matrices after one three-step epoch, not the operator norm of a mean noncommutative product or a convergence-rate upper bound. The primary RRK paper arXiv:2410.01140 proves per-permutation contraction and compares bounds/experiments, not a pointwise-initialization mean-square phase boundary. The 2012 Recht–Ré conjecture and 2020 Lai–Lim theorem concern spectral norms and do not entail Loewner domination; De Sa's 2020 higher-length reversal and 2026 metric-aware n>=5 families are distinct constructions, not an implication of this explicit three-row classification. The independently derived u=1/2 sharp threshold, three-factor minimum, and rational distinct-row robustness were not located in targeted claim-, equivalence-, and parameter searches. Negative search evidence alone does not prove novelty; inaccessible later manuscript noted as risk. The exact iid MSE/transfer identity already appears in Agaskar–Wang–Lu (2014) and is restated by Bai–Wu (2018, Theorem 2.1). The present claim is specifically the uniform Gram comparison to reshuffling, its sharp 45-degree threshold, minimal three-row reversal, and robust distinct-row witness, none of which follows from the iid formula alone.

value.rationale: An exact complete phase diagram for all starting directions on the smallest 3-labeled-row planar epoch. The coherence cutoff u=1/2 is sharp, its failure occurs for a consistent full-column-rank system and remains under distinct-row perturbations, and two labels are proved incapable of the same reversal. This directly distinguishes an exact target-dependent MSE guarantee from spectral norm and worst-permutation rate bounds, clarifying an important mathematical limit of common reshuffling heuristics. The numerical benefit is only a few percent in the explicit family; importance lies in the minimal structural sign reversal and classification, not a claim of meaningful practical speedup or broad algorithmic superiority.
